name: Sapphire Reserve for Business Credit Card

localized_names.en: Sapphire Reserve for Business Credit Card

apr.notes: APR not explicitly stated on product page. Page describes card as 'A Pay in Full credit card' with Flex for Business option. See Pricing & Terms for current APR.

categories.label: Social media and search engine advertising

rewards.redemption_notes: Points worth $0.01 each when redeemed through Chase Travel. Points Boost promotions may enhance value up to 2x. 200,000 points = $4,000 value for select flights and hotels through Chase Travel.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 200,000 points after you spend $30,000 on purchases in your first 6 months from account opening. (Main page shows 150,000 with 200,000 struck through; offer details confirm 200,000.)

benefits.title: $300 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.description: Receive up to $300 in statement credits each anniversary year for travel category purchases.

benefits.title: $250 Credit for select Chase Travel Hotels
benefits.description: Up to $250 in statement credits through 12/31/26 on prepaid Chase Travel hotel bookings for stays with IHG, Montage, Pendry, Omni, Virgin, Minor, and Pan Pacific Hotels.

benefits.title: Chase Sapphire Reserve Lounge Network
benefits.description: Complimentary access to Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club and 1,300+ Priority Pass airport lounges worldwide with up to two guests. Valued at over $850.

benefits.title: $500 Credit for stays with The Edit
benefits.description: Up to $500 in automatic statement credits annually for bookings made with The Edit, with a maximum of $250 per transaction.

benefits.title: The Edit Program Benefits
benefits.description: Complimentary benefits when booking through The Edit by Chase Travel: property credit, daily breakfast for two, room upgrade (if available) and more. Average total value over $550 per stay.

benefits.title: $120 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck/NEXUS fee credit
benefits.description: Receive one statement credit of up to $120 every four years as reimbursement for the application fee.

benefits.title: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status
benefits.description: Complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status through 12/31/27.

benefits.title: $200 Google Workspace credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 in annual statement credits on purchases made directly with Google Workspace.

benefits.title: $400 ZipRecruiter credit
benefits.description: Up to $400 in annual statement credits on purchases made directly with ZipRecruiter. Up to $200 Jan-Jun and up to $200 Jul-Dec.

benefits.title: $120 Lyft credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 in monthly in-app credits, up to $120 annually, to use on Lyft rides through 9/30/27.

benefits.title: $420 DoorDash value
benefits.description: $120 DashPass membership (12 months complimentary) plus $300 DoorDash promos ($5 monthly restaurant promo + two $10 monthly promos for groceries/retail).

benefits.title: $100 Curated Gift Card credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 per year in statement credits when purchasing gift cards from a curated collection on giftcards.com/reservebusiness.

benefits.title: Employee Cards at no additional cost
benefits.description: Employee cards at no additional cost.

benefits.title: Air Canada Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary access for cardmember and 1 guest to Air Canada's Maple Leaf Lounges and Air Canada Cafes when departing on a Star Alliance flight.

benefits.title: $120,000 Spend Benefits
benefits.description: After spending $120,000 in purchases each calendar year: World of Hyatt Explorist status, $500 credit at The Shops at Chase, IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite status, $500 Southwest Airlines Chase Travel Credit, Southwest Rapid Rewards A-List status.

lounge_access.notes: Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club + 1,300+ Priority Pass lounges (up to 2 guests) + Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounges

travel_perks.hotel_status: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite (through 12/31/27); World of Hyatt Explorist after $120K spend; IHG Diamond Elite after $120K spend
other: $250 credit for select Chase Travel Hotels (through 12/31/26)
$500 credit for stays with The Edit (annually)
The Edit program benefits (property credit, daily breakfast, room upgrade)

notes: Verified from official Chase product page. Network corrected to visa; tier normalized to bare slug 'infinite'. Earn structure verified from official page: 8X Chase Travel, 4X flights/hotels booked direct, 3X social media and search engine advertising, 1X all else. FX fee confirmed 0% (no foreign transaction fees). APR not stated on product page (card described as 'Pay in Full' with Flex for Business); preserved as null. Signup bonus: main page shows 150,000 with 200,000 struck through; offer details confirm 200,000 points.
